across_options.issue: Beyond adding card outlines, Hairline cards changes the left field from faint diagonal lines to dense curved mesh lines, makes its right edge wider, and gives it a straight vertical left edge beside the jacket. The lower item titles shift left, the inter-row spacing changes, and the bottom-navigation rule extends farther sideways. These also change field treatment and D3 spacing.

Beyond enclosing platform marks, In a bubble cuts a white notch into the offer field around the Depop mark. The eBay wordmarks are smaller and move upward within their rows. On the sold view, “You keep” is larger, lighter and higher. The field silhouette, logo scale/position and text styling therefore change along with the enclosure.

Dot adds Live and Shipping as text beneath the lower item titles and adds Sold beneath the jacket title, while Offer is conveyed by the existing offer text. This is a supporting layout/content change to the state treatment, not a photo-marker-only swap. The supporting words do mean that the colored dots are not the only state indication.
Corner tag also moves “You keep” upward and changes its gap above the sale amount. That sale-text spacing is unrelated to replacing photo pills with corner tags.

Review scope: these are Today screens, so ledger L12’s Sell-grid requirement is not a failure here. The visible More controls satisfy the presence of a third action; their menu contents cannot be verified from this board. Article 13 does not establish an AI-tell cluster merely from the authorized pills, cards or bubbles. B25’s side-by-side default comparison was not supplied. Source-only checks B13, B15, B22 and B27 are not applicable to these raster images; exact font, token and logo-asset compliance is not certified.
